sources.finding: Conversational implicature: short contextual frame licenses inference but does not prove a new fact.
Conversation analysis: story preface projects stance and sets recipient expectations.
Oral forms include myths, rumors, interviews, notes, family experience, manuscripts.
Sketchbooks and notebooks function as visual notes, observations and fragmentary material records.
Comics gutters ask readers to infer unstated connections; here used only as an analogy for elliptical narration.
Cut-up reorders text; KFB may transpose the collage feeling but must NOT cut and rearrange authoritative card Triplets.
Oral testimony is situated recollection; staged reminiscence must never masquerade as documented primary source.
